1.0: QUESTION: What is the ontological status of mathematical objects like numbers?
1.1: ASSERTS: Platonism (mathematical realism) holds that mathematical objects are real abstract entities existing independently of human minds
1.2: ASSERTS: Nominalism/Constructivism holds that mathematical objects are mental constructions and human inventions
1.3: DOCUMENT: Core tension between views - Platonism struggles to explain epistemic access to abstract entities; Nominalism struggles to explain the discovery-feeling and applicability of mathematics
1.1.1: ASSERTS: Mathematical truths exhibit objectivity and necessity difficult to explain if mathematics is merely human construction
1.1.2: ASSERTS: The Pythagorean theorem was true before humans discovered it and would remain true if humanity vanished
1.1.3: ASSERTS: Different cultures independently discovered identical mathematical truths, suggesting tracking of real entities rather than arbitrary invention
1.1.4: ASSERTS: The unreasonable effectiveness of mathematics in physics (Wigner) suggests mathematical structures exist independently and physical world instantiates them
1.1.5: OPEN: How do humans access or have knowledge of abstract entities that exist outside space and time?
1.2.1: ASSERTS: Humans have no sensory or causal contact with abstract objects, making their postulation a violation of explanatory parsimony
1.2.2: ASSERTS: Observable mathematical practice consists entirely of physical mathematicians writing symbols and following rules
1.2.3: ASSERTS: Mathematical practice can be fully explained through human activity: creating formal systems, proving theorems within them, and selecting useful systems
1.2.4: ASSERTS: Mathematical objectivity reflects consistent adherence to shared rules rather than description of independent entities
1.2.5: ASSERTS: Cultural convergence on mathematics reflects convergence on useful symbol systems rather than discovery of platonic realm
1.2.6: OPEN: Why does mathematics feel discovered rather than invented if it is merely human construction?
1.2.7: OPEN: Why does mathematics work unreasonably well in describing physical reality if mathematical objects are mere constructions?
